required_signals: UAE regulatory or professional market-entry context
navy and blue authority with white or off-white clarity
approved transparent Savoy logo with high contrast
forbidden_signals: another company's platform, casino, gaming, retail, or technology vocabulary
owner_review_required_for: a new visual family not listed in templates
a dominant color outside the approved palette
a materially different logo placement or treatment
a consumer-first or dark-only aesthetic direction
